preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100000 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and set(a) == set(range(n)) for n, a in zip(test_case_ns, test_case_as))
preconditions.description: Each test case provides a permutation of size n containing distinct integers from 0 to n-1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 1000000007 for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == count_similar_permutations(test_case_as[i], test_case_ns[i]) % 1000000007 for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the count of permutations b similar to a (where similarity is defined by equal MEX for all intervals), modulo 10^9+7.
